headline: Windows SignDrop zero-day grants SYSTEM; Apache HTTP Server critical RCE patched; N-central and ScreenConnect attacks continue

bullets.text: New: BleepingComputer reports a Windows zero-day dubbed SignDrop that gives attackers SYSTEM privileges. No CVE or fix is listed on the board yet.
New: SecurityWeek reports Apache has patched a critical HTTP Server remote code execution flaw, CVE-2026-119618, found by researchers at Anthropic and Google.

The Hacker News reports new N-central exploits that work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access, following attacks on N-central zero-days as N-able rushed patches (3 outlets).

ScreenConnect: a plugin flaw is being exploited to spread malware across hundreds of PCs and MSPs have been breached (5 outlets). New: The Hacker News describes SCKit malware that turns ScreenConnect support sessions into MSP attack paths.

Still developing: the Fireworks AI hack let attackers access Notion customers' chat transcripts (7 outlets); Apify is rotating API tokens and prompting 2FA resets after a breach. New: Hong Kong Sogo reports a breach affecting 820,000 members.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets), Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. GPUStack, OpenSSH, FreeSwitch and Aspera Faspex were due 11-12. SITCON 3 at 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Windows: watch for Microsoft guidance on SignDrop; until a fix ships, prioritise detection of local privilege escalation to SYSTEM on exposed hosts.
Apache HTTP Server: find every httpd instance, including in containers and appliances, and apply the fix for CVE-2026-119618 today.
N-central: do not rely on patches alone; keep consoles off the internet and hunt for root or SYSTEM-level compromise.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for SCKit or other malware pushed through sessions.
Fireworks AI / Notion AI and Apify users: rotate secrets that appeared in chats and Apify API tokens; reset 2FA as prompted.
Patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13; close out any overdue GPUStack, OpenSSH, FreeSwitch and Aspera Faspex KEV fixes.
